Home.title: Play Snake
Home.intro: Classic snake game, right in your browser. Eat apples, grow longer, and climb the leaderboard. No download required.
Home.start: Press an arrow key or tap to start
Home.seoBody: This is a free online snake game you can play instantly. Guide the snake with the arrow keys or swipe on mobile, eat the apples to grow longer, and avoid hitting the walls or your own tail.

Leaderboard.soon: The leaderboard will appear here once score saving is live.
Leaderboard.notRanked: Play a game to get ranked this period.

Mods.intro: Try the classic modded Snake experience. Note: scores here do NOT count toward the leaderboard.
Mods.notRanked: Fun mode — scores are not ranked.

HowToPlay.body: Use the arrow keys (or WASD) to steer the snake. On mobile, swipe in the direction you want to go. Eat apples to grow and score points. The game ends if you hit a wall or your own body.

Rewards.body: Rewards and seasonal events are coming soon.

About.body: A fast, free snake game built for the browser, with leaderboards and a classic mods mode.
